observations: Exercise bike with a digital display and control panel at the handlebars.
Orange and white color scheme on the pedals and handlebar console.
White tubular frame with adjustable height mechanism.
Watermark 'NAMISDY ENTERPRISES POSTED ON JIJI' visible on the image.

claims.evidence: The item appears clean in the photo, but 'fair used' is a subjective term for used goods.

risks.risk: The electronic display and control panel may be non-functional or have a dead battery.
risks.proof: A video showing the display powered on and the screen showing workout metrics.

risks.risk: The pedals may be loose, worn, or have a broken gear mechanism.
risks.proof: A video of the bike in motion showing the pedals turning and the resistance mechanism working.

risks.risk: The internal resistance mechanism (gears) may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the resistance dial being turned and the resistance changing.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the bike powered on and running through a full workout cycle.
Video of the pedals turning and the resistance mechanism working.
Photo of the pedals and resistance dial.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
